findings: Trading update for 1 January–30 June 2026 (H1 2026), issued ahead of statutory half-year results on 3 September 2026; not a full H1 income statement — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/GFTU.L/20260904T173351Z/sources/filings/bodies/ir_3ae4cc4aa2a00721.txt

Group revenue in H1 2026 rose 6.7% to £1.34bn (2025: £1.25bn), or 4.7% in constant currency; growth supported by HSS Hire Ireland, Cygnum (acquired 31 March 2026) and two months of Mercaluz (acquired 30 April 2026) — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/GFTU.L/20260904T173351Z/sources/filings/bodies/ir_3ae4cc4aa2a00721.txt

Group average daily like-for-like (LFL) revenue in H1 increased 0.6% in constant currency; Iberia (+6.6%), Island of Ireland (+3.4%) and Northern Europe (+0.8%) largely offset Great Britain (-5.1%) — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/GFTU.L/20260904T173351Z/sources/filings/bodies/ir_3ae4cc4aa2a00721.txt

Geographic LFL by quarter: Island of Ireland Q1 +1.6%, Q2 +5.2%; Great Britain Q1 (5.2%), Q2 (4.9%); Northern Europe Q1 +1.6%, Q2 +0.1%; Iberia Q1 +1.7%, Q2 +10.8%; Group Q1 (0.5%), Q2 +1.7% — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/GFTU.L/20260904T173351Z/sources/filings/bodies/ir_3ae4cc4aa2a00721.txt

Great Britain: LFL down 5.1% in H1 on subdued construction activity, economic/geopolitical uncertainty; businesses responded with cost management and efficiency initiatives — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/GFTU.L/20260904T173351Z/sources/filings/bodies/ir_3ae4cc4aa2a00721.txt

Island of Ireland: LFL +3.4% in H1; Chadwicks strengthened in Q2 after weather disruption; Cygnum integration progressing well; Woodie's slightly ahead of strong 2025 comparatives — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/GFTU.L/20260904T173351Z/sources/filings/bodies/ir_3ae4cc4aa2a00721.txt

Iberia: Salvador Escoda LFL +6.6% in H1, helped by favourable economic conditions, record H1 temperatures in Spain and strong sales execution in air conditioning, refrigeration and ventilation; Q1 growth hit by timing of prior-year project sales — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/GFTU.L/20260904T173351Z/sources/filings/bodies/ir_3ae4cc4aa2a00721.txt

Mercaluz (leading distributor of residential and commercial air-conditioning equipment, acquired 30 April 2026): integration progressing well and performing in line with expectations; two months of trading included in H1 revenue — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/GFTU.L/20260904T173351Z/sources/filings/bodies/ir_3ae4cc4aa2a00721.txt

Management focus on disciplined cost control and margin management; no material supply-chain disruption from Middle East geopolitical developments — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/GFTU.L/20260904T173351Z/sources/filings/bodies/ir_3ae4cc4aa2a00721.txt
